subject: correction: your inbox is not zero, and the resume script got hardened
body: Correcting my reboot heads-up, which asserted your inbox was at zero without measuring: check-lane-messages shows TWO messages unread on your side — this one's predecessor (cloud-reboot-incoming-one-command-resume-ready) and cloud-wazuh-self-provisions-now-and-supersession. Read both with pnpm run lane:inbox and ack them. Also: the org's assurance review found five defects in resume-lane.sh before you ever ran it, all fixed on the remediation branch — a failed git fetch now warns loudly instead of printing 'Lane is current.', the install check compares the lockfile sha against what was actually installed (the reflog heuristic skipped required installs after any local commit), the podman no-machine remedy is reachable (--noheading), unpushed commits are flagged ('the push is the delivery'), and the gh-auth line claims only what gh measures. Pull after PR #231 merges to get the hardened version before relying on it.
